spot_ema_moves_first.meaning: short-horizon price movement has propagated into spotEMA faster than into longer-horizon EMAs

twap_used_in_liquidation.meaning: the TWAP returned via PanopticPool.getTWAP() is the value consumed by the liquidation solvency check and the StaleOracle gate

tick_distance.meaning: |currentTick - twapTick|, the absolute tick distance between current tick and the TWAP tick used by the gate

stale_gate_misbehavior.meaning: the StaleOracle gate outcome is altered: it proceeds when it should revert as stale, or reverts when it should proceed

assumptions: The StaleOracle gate is evaluated on the TWAP returned by PanopticPool.getTWAP(), which is derived from RiskEngine.twapEMA().
tickDeltaLiquidation is a fixed positive threshold configured on the pool; its concrete value is not needed for the symbolic plan.
The gate's correct behavior is to revert when the tick distance exceeds tickDeltaLiquidation and to proceed otherwise.

unresolved.description: The report does not give the numeric value of tickDeltaLiquidation nor a concrete currentTick/twapTick pair, so whether the misweighted TWAP actually crosses the boundary is not quantified; the plan keeps the threshold and distance symbolic.
The report does not state who triggers the liquidation/stale-gate check or any authorization condition; the gate condition is modeled without a caller qualifier.

limitations: The plan formalizes only the stale_gate_misbehavior impact; the spot-weighted TWAP, blocked-liquidation bad debt and incorrect-liquidation impacts are handled in separate claim-generation passes and are not covered here.
The relation is stated as absence of the misbehavior under the stale condition; the exact revert/proceed encoding is deferred to code binding of the gate.
The spotEMA propagation precondition is represented as a report-grounded Boolean occurrence because the report gives no numeric EMA values.
